teaser: How an agent team briefs its people: four questions in order, one JSON file and a PDF, copied from the book team to the Web Summit team in one night.
core_idea: A person cannot watch a team of agents, so the team speaks to them through a brief: four questions in a fixed order (what needs you, what happened, what you asked, what next), at most three decisions with options and a recommendation, every number traced and the failures kept in. One JSON file becomes a PDF through a small tool. The method moved from the book team to the Web Summit team in one night, extended to every person and every stand-up, and on its first day caught a six-page brief, a miscount and a team where one agent in nine was on a schedule. This newsroom still briefs its editor in a chat.
